name: anime-companion-vscode
description: 🌸 Live2D anime companion in your sidebar — reacts to errors, saves, commits, builds, debug & Pomodoro. Multilingual voice + lip-sync.

animeCompanion.messageIntervalMin.description: Minimum interval (in seconds) between random messages.

animeCompanion.pomodoroWorkTime.description: Work duration for Pomodoro in minutes.

animeCompanion.pomodoroBreakTime.description: Break duration for Pomodoro in minutes.

animeCompanion.showOnStartup.description: Automatically show the companion when VS Code starts.

animeCompanion.model.description: Choose the current Live2D character model. Built-in ids: hiyori, haru, mao, miara. User-provided local model ids from `animeCompanion.customModels` also work here.

animeCompanion.voiceLanguage.description: Choose the voice language for the companion (audio only).

animeCompanion.messageLanguage.description: Choose the language for bubble text (idle/reactive messages, achievements). Independent from voice.

animeCompanion.ambientPreset.description: Background ambience preset for the companion. Built-in values: off, lofi, rain, cafe. Custom values can be selected from the Ambient panel when using animeCompanion.customAmbientTracks.

animeCompanion.ambientVolume.description: Volume for background ambience, from 0 to 100.

animeCompanion.customAmbientTracks.description: Extra local ambient tracks shown in the Ambient menu. Example: [{ "label": "My Lofi", "path": "D:/Music/lofi.mp3", "description": "Personal focus mix" }].

id.description: Optional stable id for this track.

label.description: Display name shown in the Ambient menu.

description.description: Short subtitle shown below the label.

path.description: Absolute path to a local audio file such as D:/Music/lofi.mp3.

animeCompanion.breakReminderMinutes.description: Minutes of continuous coding before break reminder.

animeCompanion.reactive.diagnostics.description: React to errors and warnings (problems panel changes).

animeCompanion.reactive.save.description: React when files are saved (including spam-save detection).

animeCompanion.reactive.typing.description: React to typing speed and keyword Easter eggs (TODO/FIXME/console.log).

animeCompanion.reactive.git.description: Poll Git state to react to branch switches, commits, merge conflicts, and many uncommitted changes.

animeCompanion.quietHours.description: Time ranges (24h format "HH:MM-HH:MM") during which all bubble messages are suppressed. Example: ["09:00-12:00", "22:00-06:00"]. Mood/expression updates still happen — only messages are muted.

animeCompanion.customPhrases.idle.description: Extra idle bubble phrases. Merged into the default idle pool for the active language.

animeCompanion.customPhrases.save.description: Extra phrases shown after a successful save. Merged into the default save pool. Supports placeholders like {filename} and {extension}.

animeCompanion.customPhrases.error.description: Extra phrases shown when new errors appear. Merged into the default error pool. Supports placeholders like {error_count}.

animeCompanion.customModels.description: User-provided local Live2D models. Each property key becomes the model id. Example: { "my-model": { "name": "My Model", "path": "D:/Live2D/MyModel", "modelFile": "MyModel.model3.json", "description": "Custom local model" } }

animeCompanion.customModelRoots.description: Root folders to auto-scan for local Live2D models. Each direct child folder is treated as one model if it contains a `.model3.json` file. Example: ["D:/model"]

animeCompanion.modelDownloadBaseUrl.description: Base URL where lazy-loaded built-in Live2D model zips are hosted. Each model is fetched as `{baseUrl}/{folder}.zip` (e.g. Haru.zip). Override if you self-host.

animeCompanion.customKeywords.description: User-defined keyword reactions. Each key is a substring (case-insensitive) to watch for in typed text; the value is a pool of messages picked when matched. Example: { "NOTE": ["Ghi chú thêm rồi nha~"], "refactor": ["Refactor là yêu lắm đó!"] }.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.enabled.description: Run the companion as a floating Desktop Companion window (Tauri sidecar) instead of in the VS Code panel. Windows-only in v1; Mac/Linux planned for v1.1+. Requires reload after toggling.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.alwaysOn.description: Keep the Desktop Companion window above other windows.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.clickThr.description: Make the Desktop Companion window ignore mouse clicks (clicks pass through to apps behind). Toggle from the tray icon.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.size.description: Size of the Desktop Companion window.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.position.description: Initial position of the Desktop Companion window. `anchor` snaps to a screen corner; `x`/`y` (optional) override with absolute coordinates persisted after dragging.

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.opacity.description: Window opacity for the Desktop Companion (0.5 = half-transparent, 1 = fully opaque).

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.download.description: Base URL where the Desktop Companion sidecar binary zips are hosted. Each platform is fetched as `{baseUrl}/{platform}.zip` (e.g. win-x64.zip).

animeCompanion.desktopCompanion.devBinar.description: Absolute path to a locally-built sidecar binary. When set, overrides the lazy-download flow. Useful for development before the official binary is published. Example: D:/anime-companion-vscode/desktop-pet/target/release/anime-companion-pet.exe

scripts.package:install: vsce package --allow-missing-repository && npm run cleanup:vsix && "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\bin\code.cmd" --install-extension "%npm_package_name%-%npm_package_version%.vsix" --force
